patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero placement with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The search evaluates all 165 point triples simultaneously, uses a soft-min objective during annealing to improve several near-critical triangles rather than only one active constraint, and retains the best true minimum-area arrangement encountered.

Barycentric simplex coordinates guarantee every proposed point remains inside the equilateral triangle after projection. The returned Cartesian coordinates use the requested triangle embedding. A fixed seed makes results reproducible, while the initial best candidate and finite search budget provide graceful behavior even if no particularly strong annealing trajectory is found.
